name: songsta-desktop
author: Songsta
description: Songsta — local music player with Jellyfin and open metadata

scripts.dev:app: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run build:electron && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.test: esbuild electron/backup-transfer.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/backup-transfer.mjs && esbuild electron/local-paths.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/local-paths.mjs && esbuild src/lib/deletion-sync.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/deletion-sync.mjs && esbuild src/lib/download-reconcile.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/download-reconcile.mjs && esbuild electron/mac-menu.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/mac-menu.mjs && esbuild src/lib/media-key-tap.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/media-key-tap.mjs && esbuild src/lib/audio-output.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/audio-output.mjs && esbuild src/lib/duplicates.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/duplicates.mjs && esbuild src/lib/releases.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/releases.mjs && esbuild src/lib/playbackFormat.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/playbackFormat.mjs && esbuild electron/jellyfin-stream.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/jellyfin-stream.mjs && esbuild src/lib/libraryTracks.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/libraryTracks.mjs && esbuild src/lib/spotifyImport.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/spotifyImport.mjs && esbuild src/lib/albumEdits.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/albumEdits.mjs && esbuild src/lib/catalogIndex.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/catalogIndex.mjs && esbuild electron/discord.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/discord.mjs && esbuild electron/lyrics.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/lyrics.mjs && esbuild src/lib/favoriteSync.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/favoriteSync.mjs && esbuild src/lib/storeLinks.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/storeLinks.mjs && esbuild src/lib/transliterate.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/transliterate.mjs && esbuild electron/m3u.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/m3u.mjs && esbuild src/lib/m3uMatch.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/m3uMatch.mjs && esbuild electron/archive-import.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=.test-build/archive-import.cjs && esbuild electron/release-date.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/release-date.mjs && esbuild electron/data-folder.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/data-folder.mjs && esbuild mobile/src/quality.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/phone-quality.mjs && esbuild mobile/src/addresses.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/phone-addresses.mjs && esbuild src/lib/syncEngine.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/syncEngine.mjs && esbuild src/lib/playlistSync.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/playlistSync.mjs && esbuild src/lib/lrc.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/lrc.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:electron && vite build
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64

linux.synopsis: Music player for your own files, Jellyfin and Navidrome
linux.description: Songsta plays the music on your computer and on your Jellyfin or Navidrome server, with lyrics, covers and artist info from open sources.
